name: Turkey Meatballs with Pasta
method: Mix the turkey mince with the egg, oats, herbs and seasoning and roll into 14 small meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in oil, then add the chopped onion and passata and simmer for 15 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Cook the penne, toss with the sauce and top with grated cheddar.
